description: Reports plan implementation results with evidence-based overall, stage, and module completion percentages; goal alignment verification; concrete engineering benefit analysis; unfinished-work impact analysis; and recommended next actions.

changes: Require plan implementation reports to include explicit concrete engineering benefits for every main goal.
Add an Engineering Benefit Matrix with metric, baseline, target, observed result, and verification evidence fields.
Add quality-bar examples that reject generic benefit claims without measurable engineering effect.
